title: Building the Temple
traveler_why: Wren is the Traveler who pauses to wonder at holy things, and tonight Solomon builds a temple full of quiet beauty: Wren tidies her room for church with her very best effort instead of good enough.
traveler_about: Wren fits tonight because Wren stops to wonder at beautiful, holy things, and Solomon built the temple to be a place full of wonder. In Wren’s world today: it is Saturday, and her room needs tidying before church tomorrow. She could shove everything under the bed and call it good enough. Instead she pauses and ponders. She folds each shirt, lines up her shoes, and hums her church song softly while she works. Just like Solomon, Wren learned that giving Heavenly Father her very best is a quiet way to say I love You.
